overall_summary: Analysis of deduplicated recent uploads reveals that space and planetary 'What If' scenarios heavily outperform standard historical or psychological factoids in views-per-day and engagement metrics (likes/comments per view). Videos featuring extreme planetary phenomena, bizarre cosmic conditions, and speculative 'What If' hooks published within the last 7 days (e.g., 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?', 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year') consistently command higher velocity than older content. Conversely, dry psychological trick lists or standard animal facts show lower relative traction.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (1,024 views) and 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?' (972 views) show exceptional view accumulation and high like-to-view ratios compared to static fact statements.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on immersive, high-stakes hypothetical scenarios involving extreme cosmic or planetary environments.

winning_patterns.evidence: Titles featuring extreme planetary oddities like 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year' (970 views) and 'The Planet Darker Than Coal: TrES-2b' (1,026 views) drive strong organic reach within days of publication.
winning_patterns.action: Continue sourcing bizarre, counter-intuitive astronomical anomalies with punchy, high-curiosity framing.

weak_patterns.evidence: Content like 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' and 'The Psychological Trick to Stop Songs Stuck in Your Head' stagnated with sub-70 views and negligible engagement.
weak_patterns.action: Deprioritize standalone psychological tips unless paired with a high-stakes narrative or cinematic micro-story format.

weak_patterns.pattern: Basic Animal Facts Without Extinction/Scale Hooks
weak_patterns.evidence: Simple declarative animal titles like 'Octopuses Have THREE Hearts' underperformed relative to cosmic content, showing weaker viral momentum.
weak_patterns.action: Shift animal-related content into cinematic animal survival or evolutionary paradoxes rather than basic trivia.

next_video.opening_direction: Start in absolute pitch-blackness with absolute zero temperature, asking the viewer what happens when a world is completely untethered from any solar system.
next_video.twist_direction: Reveal that despite the freezing void, a massive subterranean liquid ocean thrives miles beneath the surface powered entirely by tidal friction.
next_video.reason: Leverages the proven high-performing 'What If' and extreme planetary niche with a completely fresh astronomical subject (rogue planets with subsurface oceans) absent from past uploads.
